context: A boss discusses a publishing project
purpose: Teach: 毀損/百科/後編/運搬/ネック/選別/結びつける/招か

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ブランド毀損、絶対避けたい。
lines.en: Brand damage is what we absolutely cannot afford.
lines.style: Clipped, measured authority. Slight pause before the final clause. Eyes clear and steady. No negotiation in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。百科事典シリーズ、改訂を進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with revisions on the encyclopedia series.
lines.style: Even, professional delivery. Respectful pacing — not rushed. The confidence of someone reporting work already in motion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創刊号の後編、出版時期、決めろ。
lines.en: The second half of the inaugural issue. Set the publication date.
lines.style: Clipped directive. Weight on each segment. No room for questions. The tone of someone used to being understood quickly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 運搬経路、最適化済みです。
lines.en: The transport routes are already optimized.
lines.style: Factual, brief. Slight lift at the end — not defensive, just confirming. Efficient delivery matching the efficient work being described.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 倉庫キャパがネック、選別を厳しくしろ。
lines.en: Warehouse capacity is the constraint. Tighten your screening criteria.
lines.style: Problem-solver's clarity. Direct naming of the issue, then the instruction. Low cadence. Assumes Kenji will execute without explanation needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 記者会見、業界の重鎮を結びつける場にします。
lines.en: The press conference — make it an opportunity to bring industry leaders together.
lines.style: Strategic warmth breaking through the operational tone. Slightly slower on 'opportunity' — this is where the conversation shifts toward bigger vision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 招かれる側として、礼を尽くせ。
lines.en: As their guest, extend full courtesy.
lines.style: Final word from someone with power who chooses respect. Measured, almost tender beneath the control. Lets the weight of 'courtesy' land.
